title: Choose the server-browser layout
question: The live list stays. Same dests, same session rows. Pick how that table sits.

options.label: Inset board
options.thesis: A floating night-ink board on the grey studio, same family as the main dest card.
options.viewport: Grey studio around an inset board. Filters on top, 12-column list, Local/World and Join on the card.
options.risk: Less row space than a full-bleed table.

options.label: Full-bleed table
options.thesis: Edge-to-edge scan. Studio goes away so every column can breathe.
options.viewport: No studio. Header filters, full-width list, Local/World left, Join skew bottom-right.
options.risk: Drops the rider/bike stage on this screen.
